resources.string: feat(session): add portrait sessions and controls below the game

Steam, games, and Linux desktop sessions can now use Portrait or Follow device rotation independently of launcher orientation. Landscape remains the default. Resolution presets rotate with the session; custom dimensions remain exact, and older automatic resolution preferences retain preset behavior.
Make the performance HUD measure the game\'s frames like Steam\'s overlay

The performance HUD (green, top right) showed a jagged frame-time line and a lower fps than Steam\'s performance overlay (MangoHud) for the same game. In Among Us, Steam showed a flat 60 fps line while the HUD read 51-56 fps with spikes.
Pushed to main without a PR - fix: stop starting a session on the slow proot (#1395)
refactor: remove duplicate session frame limiter

DroidDeck\'s Mode settings frame cap duplicates Steam QAM and can leave users with two competing limiters. Remove the session-wide control and its saved-setting/runtime wiring so Steam\'s Quick Access menu owns Steam game frame limits.
fix: show a desktop window game\'s real fps on the HUD
In the KDE desktop, a game started from Steam runs in a desktop window (#1584), but the performance HUD showed 0 fps the whole time even though the game was running smoothly.
fix: Battle.net games the Agent no longer tracks stay out of the Library

Battle.net games that were no longer installed still showed in the Library, Steam and the Stores grid. World of Warcraft and StarCraft also vanished from the Battle.net client even though their files were still on the Games folder (124 GB and 5.4 GB).
fix: list Battle.net store games in a grid that scrolls down

The Battle.net store put its whole catalog in a single \"Blizzard games\" shelf. That made one row that scrolled sideways, with empty space below. The shelf also stops at 24 cards, so the last 7 of the 31 titles could not be reached at all: Warcraft II: Remastered, Warcraft Rumble, Doom: The Dark Ages, Sea of Thieves, The Outer Worlds 2, Tony Hawk\'s Pro Skater and Avowed.
Hold games to the frame limit in Performance mode
With Performance mode on and a frame limit set, games are now held to the limit instead of drawing frames the screen never shows.
feat(ui): support portrait launcher layouts

DroidDeck can now follow device rotation or stay in portrait. Tall windows use navigation at the bottom edge, while landscape keeps the side rail. Launcher orientation is separate from Steam/game/desktop orientation and also applies to the file browser, file picker, and store sign-in activities.
feat: install Battle.net games from Stores with downloads, updates and uninstall
Battle.net games now install from Stores the same way Epic, Xbox and itch games do:
DroidDeck-Proton is downloaded, kept up to date and used by default
DroidDeck-Proton becomes the Proton games use by default. It is downloaded on its own, kept up to date, and each update replaces the older build without losing anyone\'s choices.
feat: merge Games and store libraries into one Library and one game page

The same game could be found in three places with two different detail pages. Now there is one Library for every owned game, one game page for every source, and Stores is only for getting games. The Steam tab is untouched.
fix: GOG sign-in pages use the browser\'s own user agent
Fixes #1486
Xbox Cloud Gaming: stream from the store and Games tab, native player with DroidDeck frame generation
Stream Xbox games with Xbox Cloud Gaming from DroidDeck, outside the Linux session, with an opt-in native player that runs DroidDeck\'s own frame generation on the stream.
Xbox: fix sign-in on phones with a slow StrongBox Keystore
Share installed games between the arm64 and x86-64 Steam clients

The x86-64 Steam client and the arm64 one kept separate libraries, so a game installed in one showed as not installed in the other and had to be downloaded again. Each client now sees the other\'s installed games as installed and runs them from the same files.
Focus flatpak and other sandboxed shortcuts in gaming mode

A Flatpak app added to Steam as a non-Steam game opened from Big Picture, but the screen stayed on Steam\'s loading spinner with only the app\'s sound. Battle.net launched the same way (DD-273) showed the same thing.
Automatically update installed Proton builds on app open

Automatically update installed Proton families while idle under suitable network and power conditions, preserving older builds and pinned selections with launch exclusion and a persistent retry cooldown (30 focused tests passed).
fix(desktop): keep the Desktop page from overlapping on phones

On phones in landscape, the Desktop page\'s big \"Desktop\" title overlapped the Emulators & apps cards once the desktop was installed. The Uninstall button sat under the store and + buttons, which made that block taller and pushed the title up into the cards.
Stop the library helper when the KDE Steam client exits
After you quit Steam\'s desktop client in KDE, it could not be opened again until the session restarted. The second launch waited and then reported that the desktop client did not become ready.
